alwaysPullBeforeWorktree: Always pull before creating a new worktree
branchTemplateIssueKey: Alias for ticket. Use whichever name reads better in your template.
branchTemplateLiteralPrefix: Write literal prefixes directly, for example <0>{{example}}</0>.
branchTemplateSuffix: Short random suffix. Optional, but recommended to avoid branch name clashes. Example: {{example}}.
branchTemplateTaskId: Kandev task UUID, sanitized for branch names. Example: {{example}}.
branchTemplateTicket: Task identifier first; otherwise Jira, Linear, GitHub issue, or GitHub PR metadata. Examples: {{example}}.
branchTemplateTitle: Task title sanitized to lowercase ASCII, hyphen-separated, max 20 chars. Example: {{example}}.
branchTemplateTitleFull: Same sanitizing as title, but max 80 chars. Example: {{example}}.
cleanupScriptHelp: Runs when the task is completed to clean up the workspace.
copyFilesHelp: Gitignored paths copied into new worktrees. Append <0>{{symlink}}</0> to an entry to link it back to the main repo. Use <1>{{escapedSymlink}}</1> for a literal filename ending in <2>{{symlink}}</2>.
copyFilesPathsResolved: Paths are resolved relative to the repository root and seeded into every new worktree, preserving their relative location. Existing files in the worktree are not overwritten.
copyFilesPatternGlobstar: <0>{{globstar}}</0> matches any number of directories, e.g. <1>{{example}}</1>
copyFilesPatternLiteral: <0>{{pattern}}</0> literal file or directory (directories copy recursively)
copyFilesRemoteFallback: Remote executors copy file contents instead of creating symlinks.
copyFilesSizeLimit: Files over {{limit}} are skipped when copying to remote executors. Local worktrees copy them without a size cap.
deleteRepositoryConfirm: This will remove the repository and its scripts. This action cannot be undone.
deleteRepositoryActiveSessions_one: This repository is used by {{count}} active agent session. Stop or finish it before deleting the repository.
deleteRepositoryActiveSessions_other: This repository is used by {{count}} active agent sessions. Stop or finish them before deleting the repository.
devScriptHelp: Used to start the preview dev server for this repository. Use <0>{{port}}</0> for automatic port allocation.
discoverRepositoryDescription: Select a discovered repository or provide an absolute path to validate.
environmentSecretsDescription: Bind stored secrets to environment keys for tasks using this repository. Secret values are never shown here.
noAvailableEnvironmentSecrets: No Global or Workspace secrets are available.
environmentSecretKeyInvalid: Use a valid POSIX environment key.
environmentSecretKeyDuplicate: Each environment key can be bound only once.
environmentSecretKeyReserved: This environment key is reserved by Kandev.
environmentSecretRequired: Select a stored secret for each environment key.
repositoriesReadOnlyImprove: Repositories in this workspace are managed by Improve Kandev and cannot be changed.
manageWorkspaceDetails: Manage workspace details and jump into workflows or repositories.
name: Name
noWorkspacesConfigured: No workspaces configured. Add your first workspace to get started.
setupScriptHelp: Runs when the repo is cloned or a git worktree is created.
typeWorkspaceNameToConfirm: Type the workspace name <0>{{name}}</0> to confirm deletion. This action cannot be undone.
repositoryNameMustBeOneFolder: The repository name must be one folder name.
sourceChooseRepoAndBranch: Choose a repository and base branch.
sourceEnterValidRemoteUrl: Enter a valid remote repository URL and base branch.
sourceRepoBranchAlreadySelected: This repository and branch are already selected.
repositorySetsDescription: Named groups of this workspace's repositories. Choosing a set in the task dialog fills the repository picker with its members; branches are still chosen per task.
repositorySetsEditorDescription: Pick the repositories in this set and the order they fill the picker.
repositorySetsDeleteDescription: The set is removed. Its repositories, and any task already using them, are not affected.
repositorySetsEmpty: No repository sets yet. Create one to fill the task dialog's repository picker in a single action.
repositorySetsNoMembers: No repositories in this set. Its repositories were removed from the workspace.
repositorySetsNoRepositories: This workspace has no repositories to add yet.
repositorySetsMembersHint: Select at least one. The order here is the order they are added to a task.
repositorySetsNameTaken: A set with this name already exists in this workspace.
repositorySetsMemberRejected: One of the chosen repositories is no longer available in this workspace.
repositorySetsSaveFailed: Could not save the set. Try again.
repositorySetsAlreadyDeleted: This set was already deleted. Refresh to see the current list.
repositorySetsDeleteFailed: Could not delete the set. Try again.
coordinatorGrantsDescription: Grant coordinator tasks the authority to inspect documents, stop or interrupt unrelated tasks, and attach workspace sources within the selected scope.
createGrantDescription: Grant a task the authority to coordinate tasks across this workspace or workflow.
coordinatorTaskIdDescription: The UUID of the task that will hold coordinator authority.
scopeKindDescription: Workspace scope covers all tasks; workflow scope limits the grant to one workflow.
capabilitiesDescription: Inspect allows reading documents and relations; orchestrate allows stopping, interrupting, and attaching workspace sources.
noGrants: No coordinator grants configured for this workspace.
grantRevokeFailed: Failed to revoke grant. Try again.
grantCreateFailed: Failed to create grant. Try again.
